tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag lcags sdig gnam thog me'i skor gyi phrin las snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba zab pa'i mthar thug bzhugs so//

'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag lcags sdig gnam thog me'i skor gyi phrin las snying po zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi snying rjes khros pa'i dpa' bo des// log rtog dpung tshogs bsad pa'i khrag 'thung bas// rab myos sgyu 'phrul gar gyi 'gro 'di ko// rdul bral zhing du 'dren mdzad der btud nas// zla gsang sprin sngon rol ba'i lha lam du// drag sngags dbyar rnga'i nga ro sgrog bzhin par// phrin las gnam lcags lce 'bab mi bzod pas// gdug byed mgo snying 'gems 'di yi ger brtsam// sdom ni/ legs bshams skyabs sems sngon gtor sbyin// bka' bsgo mtshams bcad srung 'khor bsgom// brda sgo brda phyag bshags byin dbab// mchod pa byin rlabs ting 'dzin gsum// rten dang brten bskyed spyan drangs bzhugs// dbang bskur phyag mchod 'dod gsol bstod// 'dzab bzla 'dzab bstod rdzogs rim bsgom// tshogs bskul zor 'phang chad mdo dang*// brtan skyong rta bro dngos grub blang*// bshags pa nyer bsdu smon lam bsdu// shis brjod kyis ni don rnams bsdu// dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pas dur khrod la sogs pa las dang mthun par/ rab gnas dang ldan pa bkram pa'i mdun du bhan+dha'am mchog gi khog par 'bru nag gi dpal bshos nang khong gseng gru gsum sum brtsegs su yod pa lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bshos bus bskor/ dkar dmar dang*/ sha sna dang*/ khrag sna dang*/ snying snas brgyan/ thod pa mtshan ldan lcang lo can du sman/ bhan+dha skya g.yel du rak+ta/ yi dwags kyi lhung bzed du rabs chad nag po/ rta nag */g.yag nag gsum gyi tsit+ta rgyud don man ngag ltar chas su bcug pa dar nag gis bkab/ phyi nang gsang mchod rol mo la sogs pa mkho ba'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par byas/ stan bde bar/ kha lhor phyogs pas/ skyabs sems ni/

hūm̐ */ dus 'di nas ni byang chub bar| |bla ma zil gnon mchog gsum sogs// bslu med skyabs gnas mchog rnams la// kun nas dang bas skyabs su mchi// gsum/ hūm̐ */ ma rig 'khrul ba'i sems can rnams// bde chen sa la 'god pa'i phyir// phyag rgya zil gnon rab bsnyen nas// phrin las rnam bzhis don bya'o// gsum/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ */ a+ye nyid stong pa chos 'byung steng*// ma skyes skye 'gag med pa las// rgyu rkyen sngags las ma bskyed par// rol pa chen po'i sku ru gsal// rang rig phyag rgya chen por brjid// e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ zhes skad cig gis zil gnon gyi nga rgyal bskyed/ gtor ma gsum sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod yon dang ldan pa 'di phyogs skyong*/ lha klu/ gza' skar/ rgyal chen 'jigs byed dang bcas pa/ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga rnams la 'bul lo// zil gnon bsnyen zhing sgrub pa'i bar chad sol/ mthun rkyen sgrubs shig /sa bdag sa'i lha mo brtan ma/ srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu/ rje'i mgur lha bcu gsum/ mtha'i dge bsnyen nyer gcig /bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis/ gnas 'di'i yul lha gzhi bdag la sogs pa rnams la 'bul lo// sgrub pa chen po la 'bad par ru nga dang phrag dog ma bgyid par phan pa'i sdong grogs gyis shig /bgegs tshogs log 'dren nam mkha' la 'phyo ba/ bar snang la rgyu ba/ sa gzhi la 'grim pa/ 'byung ba la brten pa/ skyabs grib la gab pa/ bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi sgrub pa chen po mthong thos mi bzod pa thams cad gtor mas tshim par gyis la/ rang rang gi gnas su dengs shig /ces dang*/ bka' bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐ */ a+ye nga ni khro rgyal zil gnon sku// nag po'i cha lugs gtum khro rngam// thams cad ji ltar zhi gyur kyang*// zhi ba thams cad nga yi sku// thams cad ji ltar khros gyur kyang*// khro bo thams cad nga yi sku// bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs// rngan sbyin gtor ma 'di khyer la// da lta nyid du phyir dengs shig

/gal te mi 'gro nyams par bgyi/ a+ye dun ka yaṃ sarba bhū ta gats+tsha/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod/ mtsham gcod srung 'khor ni/ hūm̐ */ nga ni gshed po las kyi rgyal// 'khor los sgyur ba'i rang bzhin mchog /thugs srog a+ye yi 'phro 'du las// steng 'og phyogs mtshams rtsibs bcu 'bar// steng du hūm̐ dkar phyogs mtshams rim// rnam rgyal shar dbyug sngon shar lho gshin rje'i gshed lho// mi g.yo lho nub rta mgrin nub 'dod rgyal nub byang dang*// bdud rtsi byang khams gsum rnam par rgyal byang shar// 'og tu stobs chen kun kyang mthing*// g.yas g.yon tho ba sdigs mdzub bsgrengs// dur khrod chas gsol smad phur bu// steng gi tshangs pa phyogs mtshams rim// dbang po shar 'chi bdag lho klu nub gnod sbyin byang*// me lha shar lho srin po lho nub rlung nub byang dbang ldan byang shar// 'og tu sa bdag snying khar gzir// 'khor lo 'khor bas bgegs tshogs sgrol// slar yang thugs ka'i a+ye las ni| |sna tshogs mtshon cha rno dbal ldan// khro bo khro mo khro chung tshogs// dug lnga 'joms byed ye shes me// spros pas 'khor lo'i phyi rol gyi phyogs bcur gtams shing 'khrigs// sra brtan mi 'gyur gur khang gyur// rang rig spros bral phyag rgya che// gnyis 'dzin med pa mtshams kyi mchog /a+ye myag ya rngub mug shag ka dun kro dha rā dza shas+t+ra ag+ne rak+ṣa bi tā na pañdzi ra re kha dz+wa la hūm̐ phaṭa| brda sgo dbye ba ni/ hūm̐ */ dkyil 'khor rang bzhin rnam par dag /sgo phyogs lhun grub ye nas gnas// ma rig gis bsgribs rang byung rig /ye shes gsal ba'i sgo dbye'o// badz+roṅghā ṭa pra we sha yā mi/ brda phyag ni/ hūm̐ */ don dam dmigs med bde chen dbyings// gnyis med mnyam yangs spros bral yang*// kun rdzob rten 'byung 'brel ba'i ngor// brda yi mtshon nas phyag bgyi'o| |maṇ+ḍal na maḥr ro mi/

bshags pa ni/ hūm̐ */ rtsa brgyud bla ma zil gnon lha// mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho dgongs// bdag cag ma rig 'khrul ba'i blos// nongs gyur sku gsung thugs yon tan// rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig las// 'gal 'khrul bgyis kun gnong 'gyod kyis// bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ ya ma rā dza sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ sogs yig brgya brjod/ byin dbab pa ni/ hūm̐ */ chos nyid mnyam pa'i ngang nyid las// zil gnon sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i gar// ye shes rnam rol 'khor bcas kyi// byin rlabs kun 'byung rtags mtshan ston| |dbang dang dngos grub deng stsol cig /oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya ā we sha ya pheṃ pheṃ/ mchod pa byin brlab ni/ bdud rtsi la/ hūm̐ */ mtshan ldan bhan+dha pad 'dab brgyad kyi steng du// sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam lnga las// rigs lnga yab yum bcas sa bon las// lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar rang rang gi sngags 'od gsal 'bar| |oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ māṃ lāṃ pāṃ bāṃ tāṃ/ 'dzab bzlas lha zhu bdud rtsir gyur// kha chod nyi ma'i steng du rta mgrin dmar po gyi// thugs kar nyi ma'i dbus su hrīḥyig dmar po gsal| |rang gi mtheb mdzub nyi zla sngags a āḥhūm̐ bcas las// 'od 'phros lha rigs lnga yab yum bskul sbyor mtshams nas// bcud bab byang sems dkar dmar bdud rtsi la thim zhing*// mthar lha sngags thams cad 'od zhu bdud rtsir zhu// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ lan gsum/ rak+ta la/ hūm̐ */ thod rlon zla gam dmar po'i nang*/ /pad ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su 'og gi sngags// dang 'khor zhing bzlas pas rak+ta bab// rgyu rkyen kun ldan rba klong 'phyo// rak+ta'i steng du dmar mo gī ti gar bsgyur zhing*// de thim ye shes rak+ta 'bar| |oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ

lan gsum/ gtor ma/ hūm̐ */ rlung me thod sgyed la gnas pa'i// gtor snod mtshan ldan kā pa lar// pad 'dab brgyad steng bdud rtsi lnga// lcags kyu lnga dang bcas pa la// rigs lnga yab yum sa bon spras// de steng a las zla ba'i kha chod bkab pa'i steng du/ /hūm̐ mthing āḥ dmar oṃ dkar brtsegs mar gsal rlung g.yos rang gi sna bug gi rlung bus pas bdud rtsi'i 'og gi me sbar// rdzas zhu skyon sbyangs nus ldan bsam// slar zla ba sngags dang bcas pa bdud rtsir thim// de steng zil gnon gyi skur gsal ba'i/ */thugs srog hūm̐ gi 'od kyis sangs rgyas dang*// byang sems thugs rje byin rlabs bsdus// bdud rtsir bstims shing lha zil gnon zhu bas// ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho che// 'dod dgu'i yon tan lnga ldan gyur| |oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba ling+ta te dz+wa ba ling+ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ lan gsum/ mchod pa gzhan rnams/ hūm̐ */ rang nyid zil gnon thugs srog hūm̐ las// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ spros mchod tshogs kyi| |nyes pa bsregs gtor bkrus sbyangs te// slar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥ hrīḥspros thim pas mchod yon dang*// me tog spos dang mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dang*// dri ro reg chos mchod pa rnams// zag med bde chen rdzas su gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shapad/ rū pa/ shapad/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she/ dharma dhā tu/ gī ti/ nṛ t+yai/ ta na ga ṇa pañtsa ha la ma hā pū dza hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ ting 'dzin gsum/ hūm̐ */ chos sku gdod nas spros dang bral// gzung 'dzin gnyis stong 'dus ma byas// bsam brjod bral ba 'od gsal ngang*// dngos po'i mtshan ma rdul tsam med// oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/

gang la'ang mi rtog mi dmigs pa// rtog bral de yi rang mdangs las// dmigs med snying rje ngang gis shar// yon tan ye shes sgyu ma'i rtsal// a dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa bi shud+dho3haṃ/ hūm̐ */ sku yi sgyu ma'i phyag rgya che// chu zla me long gzugs brnyan bzhin// cir yang snang mod las skabs kyis// phye bas rang rig 'khor 'das thams cad kyi srog gi yi ge e ru shar// hūm̐ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐/ rten bskyed pa ni/ a+ye/ de las e yaṃ baṃ suṃ raṃ| |keṃ chad 'og nas rim bzhin du// mkha' mthing gru gsum rlung ljang gzhu// khrag mtsho dmar zlum sa dkyil ser// gru bzhi me 'bar zur gsum 'bar// rus pa'i ri rab brjid pa'i steng*| |a+ye las rang nyid skad cig ni// e ka tsa ti sku mdog mthing*// mi lpags gsol zhing dur khrod kyi// chas ldan thugs kar bh+yo yi mthar// a+ye a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa hrīḥṣ+ṭī a pa ye hūm̐/ bskor ba de las 'od 'phros pas// snod bcud 'od zhu 'gro don byas// rgyal ba sras bcas rtsa ba gsum// dam can kun gyi byin rlabs bsdus e ka tsa ti la thim// chos nyid a+ye yi rang bzhin la// ka las nyon mongs sna tshogs bcom// dur khrod rus pa'i ri rab kyi steng du mthing nag 'bar ba'i dbus// pad ma rdor dur khrod me ri'i nang*// pad ra'i nang du 'obs chen bcu drug kun nas 'jigs pa de'i dbus su// bh+rūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lter// mtha' dbus med pa'i gzhal yas khang*// phyi ni rin chen sna tshogs 'bar// nang ni dur khrod rdzas ldan rngam// gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid snang stong la sogs pa'i rdzogs// thod skam rlon nem gsum pa'i rtsig pa khrag dang zhag gis sbyar ba// yas sgo'i mas them pa glang chen 'brug /'gram gnyis seng ge sgo stag gzig

/rus sbal ka gdan lha'i ka ba// gza' klu ka gzhu gdung ma dral// tshangs pa'i lcam la zhing gi tog /chu srin kha bad sgyu skar gyi// dra mig nya sbrul za ra tshags// sgyu ma mi snying keng rus brgyan// zhing gi 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan bsgrengs// steng du mchod rten nyi zla'i tog /'od stong 'bar ba lhun sdug brjid// rta babs mchod rten tog dang bcas// bya khyung 'bar ba'i char khebs can// phyi nang phyogs mdog 'od zer 'bar// de dbus mthing nag gru gsum logs gcig mdun du bstan pa e// zla gam dmar po gsum gyis bskor| |gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi de'i phyed brgyad de'i phyed// gru chad margad brjid ldan dbus// pho brang dbus kyi e yi gzhal yas su/ de'i dbus su// klu sbrul nag gi rnam pa 'bum gnyan lcong mo khri sa bdag sbal nag gi rnam pa stong*// phyogs skyong bcu po gan rkyal bsnol ba'i steng*// ma he sngon po rat+nas brgyan pa brgyad bsnol ba'i khrir// rin po che'i pad sdong gi steng du 'khor lo sngon po ni// rtsibs stong lte bar zla nyi'i dbus// brten bskyed pa ni/ rang rig e las rdzogs pa'i lha// dpal chen khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed// zil gnon dug chen ha la'i mdog /g.yas zhal dkar bzhad nyi zla'i 'od zer ltar 'phro ba klu 'bum gsol// g.yon zhal dmar rak+ta'i rba klong 'khrugs pa gshe gnyan khri za// dbus mthing rab tu rngam pa sa bdag stong sde 'cha'// dbu skra kham nag mkha' la 'phyo// dbu la thod skam lnga lnga sbrul chun 'phyangs pa rtser rin chen// spyan dgu dmar zlum sdang mig bsgrad// smin ma ag tshom me ltar 'bar// shangs gnyer zhal gdangs ljags 'dril zhing*// mche ba bcu gnyis rno dbal gtsigs// ha he phaṭa dang bh+yo la sogs// zhal ni rngam sgra dgu dang ldan// 'khor lo rtsibs stong ral gri rdo rje g.yas// be con gtun shing sdigs mdzub rtse nas me 'bar ba zhags pa dang bcas pa mngon rtogs dang bstod bskul gnyis kar g.yas gnyis par rdo rje/

gsum par ral gri dang*/ gyang 'gyel du de nyid go log dang*/ mngon rtogs su g.yon gnyis pa sdigs mdzub zhags pa bcas| |gyang 'gyel dang bstod bskul du g.yon par gtun shing byas 'dug /gyang 'gyel du zhags pa mi 'dug /gsang sgrub g.yu spyang du sdigs mdzub me 'bar ba dang rtsa rgyud du sdigs mdzub kho nar gsungs so// g.yon// zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gar// bdud srin mu stegs rgyal btsan sogs// gdug pa'i mgo phreng lnga bcu gcig /tsit+tar bcas pa'i se ral kha// sku stod gnyis 'thung bla gos 'chang*/ sked par zhing chen ske rags la// sku smad stag gi mthang gos sbrul nag gis bcings te mnabs// dpral mdor thal chen tshom bu la// og lkog zhag gi zo ris can// mkhur tshos rak+ta'i thig les brgyan| |yan lag dang ni lhu tshigs rnams// klu gdug rigs bzhis rgyal rigs sbrul dkar po'i rna rgyan bram ze dmar po'i phyag gdub dang dpung rgyan dang dmangs gdol nag po'i zhabs gdub kun nas brgyan// rje rigs ser po mchod phyir thogs// rin chen rus pa dar gyis brgyan// rdo rje'i gshog rgod gshog ni ur mo gyang 'gyel dang mngon rtogs gzhan rnams la ni mi 'dug /bstod bskul chen po dang mngon rtogs chen mo gnyis su 'dug pas don la yod med gang 'dod byas pas chog 'dra/ ldan de'i thugs kar// ya ma rā dza smug tsit+ta'i gur khang du nag mthing*// g.yas g.yon 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa snying phreng 'dzin| |sbrul dang thod skam sku stod la glang chen sku smad la stag sham can// pho gdon 'gugs sgrol de'i thugs kar tsit+ta'i gur nang na// dregs pa phyag rdor ljang nag rngam// g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga 'dzin| |g.yon pas gyang 'gyel sgom yig tu rin po che'i tsit+ta zhes gsungs/ snying phreng lnga'ang zer ba 'dug snying 'byin zhal du gsol// dur khrod chas brgyad gtso dang mthun// mo gdon dbang sdud de'i thugs kar tsit+ta'i gur khang gi dbus// srid gsum khyams khang rus sbal ser skabs la lar dmar po'ang snang*// 'jigs byed chen po thur tu blta// mtshon cha'i spu la nyi zla'i spyan// yan lag lnga la rang byung gi mchod rten lnga gyang 'gyel du yan lag drug la mchod rten drug 'byung*// gdug pa'i mche sder lcags las grub// yan lag drug la mtshan rtags ni// rak+ta'i thig le sme drug ldan// thugs kyi gsang mdzod chen po na// 'khor lo 'bar ba'i them bar du// bsgrub bya'i rnam shes srog dang gzugs// mtshon cha'i ltem la bskyon te gsod// bdag gi spyi bor bya khyung dkar// 'khor lo spu gri gcod byed kyi// 'dab gshog gnam lcags mchu sder zangs kyi rwa dang sder mo gzi'i mig la dung gi so zhes mngon rtogs chen mor gsungs so/

can// phyag gnyis gdug pa klu zhal 'dren// spyan mig nyi zla'i zer dang ldan// spyi bor nor bu rin chen 'bar// klu gdon dug rnams 'joms par byed khyung dang ma mo phyag rdor rus sbal rnams mngon rtogs chen por gsungs pa dang bstod bskul chen mor gling dgu'i phyogs bzhir bskyed par gsungs kyang 'dir spyi gtsug tu khyung dang ya ma phyag rdor rus sbal gsum gtso bo'i thugs kar bskyed pa ni rtsa rgyud sdig pa snying 'dzing gi le'u bcu pa dang ur mo gyang 'gyel du gsungs pa ltar gtso bor byas pa'o// phrag gong gnyis su khyung mo smug nag gnyis dang*// nu 'jings gnyis su seng ge ral pa sprug pa gnyis// sog phrag gnyis su stag mo mi ro za ba gnyis// sta zur dug sbrul kha na me 'bar ba klu gdug 'joms// zung re gyad gnon rgyan gyi lha// bdag gi ba spu'i bu ga nas// rdo rje nas tsam mang po dang*// khro chung mthing nag be con dang*// tsit+ta thogs pa mang po yis// spyi bo zhabs mthil yan chad du// dra gur bzhin du rab tu gtams// gtso bo'i pang ngam gru gsum g.yon// sbyor yum be tā gyang 'gyel du rdo rje khro mo gsungs pa dang don gcig nag mo ni// phyag gnyis tsit+ta gsang sgrub tu gri gug gsungs bhan+dha stob// ral pa'i zur phud gser g.yu mu tig gis brgyan pa mun ltar gtibs// gzig sham dar dpyangs gyang 'gyel du yum la'ang dur khrod kyi chas yab dang 'dra bar gsungs thod sbrul brgyan// zhabs gnyis 'khyud dam dor stabs can// ma srin thams cad dbang du sdud// gru g.yon sgrol yum ral gcig e ka tsa ti sngo// dug sbrul rgyan 'chang ro gdan 'gying*// mi lpags re lde'i stod smad g.yogs| |ral pa nyi zla nor bus mdzes// phyag g.yas ral gri 'bar ba dang*// g.yon pas g.yu spyang mgo dgu 'gyed// gru g.yas dbyings yum srid pa'i rgyal mu kha le// mthing nag mi lpags g.yang gzhis brgyan// byu ru'i phreng rgyan stag sham can// thod sbrul dar brgyan ral pa ni// spyi gtsug 'khyil pa rma byas brgyan// g.yas g.yon khram shing nad rkyal 'dzin// baṃ chen gdan la brkyang bskum tshul// zla gam gsum la thod mkhar nang*// mdun du sku sprul tshe bdag nag

/dbu dgu zhabs brgyad phyag bco brgyad// steng gi dbu gsum mkha' lding khyung*// bar ma gsum ni stag dbus gzig g.yas dom g.yon// rtsa zhal dbus mthing g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba la// g.yas dgu steng nas rim bzhin 'khor lo ral gri dang*// rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ mdung thung dug mda'// dbyig pa rgya gram lcags kyu 'dzin// g.yon dgu steng nas rim bzhin be con gtun shing dang*// sbrul zhags kha ṭ+wāṃ sdigs mdzub gri// dgra sta g.yang gzhi tsit+ta'i phreng*// glang lpags gyon zhing ha hā sgrog /yum ni dbyings phyug rak+sha kro dhī'ang zer rgyal mor bcas// gnyan khams pho mo'i khri la 'gyings// 'khor du tshe bdag 'bum gyis bskor// g.yon du gsung sprul srog bdag dmar// khro gdong dgu la steng bya rog /g.yas pa gnam lcags be con la// g.yon pa rgyu zhags dgra la 'phen// mi lpags gyon nas sa bdag brdzis/ /yum ni dug hrul ma re ma ti'ang zer dang bcas// 'khor du srog bdag 'bum gyis bskor// g.yas su thugs sprul 'chi bdag nag /chu srin rgyal mtshan sbrul gdengs dgu// dgra sta g.yas la sbrul zhags g.yon| |sku smad dug sbrul chun po 'khyil// rus sbal g.yang gzhi gos su gyon// yum ni khrag 'jib ma dus mtshan ma'ang zer dang bcas// klu steng klu bdud 'bum gyis bskor// yum gsum de gsum gyis dmar mo spu gri thod khrag 'dzin// de yi phyi rol rtsibs bzhi la// thod mkhar 'bar ba bzhi yi nang phyi nang gsang ba'i gshed chen bcu gnyis lo gshed bcu gnyis kyi gshed du mngon rtogs chen mor gsungs// gsang hūm̐ */ lha yi lha mchog zil gnon che| |gtso bor bcas pa rang snang tsam// mos pa blor bzung lha tshogs la// rab gus dang bas phyag bgyi'o// e ka he dun ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra na mo na maḥ phyi mchod ni/ hūm̐ */ phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor bcas la// mchod yon me tog spos mar me// dri chab zhal zas rol mo dang*// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos// rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis kyi// rtags rdzas brgyad brgyad la sogs pa// stong gsum stong chen 'jig rten du// bdag pos bzung dang ma bzung ba'i// 'dod yon thams cad 'bul gyi bzhes// e ka he dun ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shapad/ rū pa/ shapad/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she/ dharma dhā tu/ sap+ta rat+na/ aṣ+ṭa maṅga laṃ sarba pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ nang mchod/ phyugs chen dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ mtsho ltar bskyil// dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog tshar du dngar// sha chen spos bsregs nam mkha' bar snang bsnyegs// tshil chen mar me bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar// mkhris chen dri chab lbu phreng rba klong g.yo// sha rus zhal zas lhun po ji bzhin spungs// thod rnga rkang gling 'brug stong sgra ltar sgrog /dur khrod nang gi mchod pa rngam brjid tshogs| |gshin rje'i gshed po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// e ka he dun ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ shapad pra tīts+tsha pū dza hoḥ gsang mchod ni/ hūm̐ */ thabs shes pho mo snyoms zhugs pa'i// zla zer ga pur kun+da dang*// nyin par gyi ni mtshan chen bcas// 'bul gyi bzhes shig dgyes par rol// e ka he dun ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra shu kra rak+ṣa pū dza hoḥ sman mchod ni/ hūm̐ */ rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag pa'i rdzas// rtsa brgyad yan lag stong la sbyar ba'i sman// rigs lnga ye shes rnam pa lnga yi dngos// nyon mongs dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi mchog

rang nyid gdod nas lha ru dag /mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa'i dngos// 'khor gsum dmigs med spros dang bral// don dam mchod pa'i mchog 'di dag /phyag rgya chen po'i tshogs la 'bul// e ka he dun ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ma hā mu dra ma hā pū dza a la la hoḥ 'dod don gsol ba ni/ hoḥ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las ma lus pa'i bdag nyid khro bo thams cad kyi rje btsun bcom ldan 'das khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed phyag rgya zil gnon ya ma rā dza/ dregs pa phyag rdor/ rus sbal rngam pa/ mkha' lding rgyal po/ gyad gnon rgyan gyi lha brgyad/ dbyings sgrol sbyor ba'i yum gsum/ sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa rnam gsum/ gshed chen sde bzhi/ mon pa bzhi/ bdud po bzhi/ zla ba'i 'chi bdag bcu gnyis/ phung byed sbas pa'i ma bzhi/ zhag gi gshin rje so gnyis/ dus bzhi srid pa'i thun bdag sgo ba bzhi/ za ma'i gshin rje bdun brgya nyi shu/ 'obs srung bcu drug /sprul pa yang sprul/ bka' nyan las byed ma gshin sha za yi dwags 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa bdag la gsan cing dgongs su gsol| sngags 'chang sgrub pa po bdag gis lha mchog khyod nyid sgrub par dam bcas nas/ phyi nang gsang ba de kho na khyad par gyi pū dza mchod pas mnyes par gyur cig /khas 'ches kyang lag len dman pa thugs dang 'gal ba thams cad bzod par mdzod cig /bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i go 'phang thob par 'dod pas lha khyod bsnyen zhing mthar thug don dam mchog gi dngos grub da lta nyid du bstsal du gsol/ gnas skabs kyi 'dod don phrin las su gsol ba ni/ 'jig rten mthong ba'i chos 'di la/ zhi bas dug dang mtshon| nad sna tshogs/ gdon dang bgegs byad dang rbod gtong*/ gcan gzan btson ra dmag sogs rgyal po'i 'jigs pa ste/

tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam shes tshogs brgyad der snang rtog pa'i gshed// dga' ba brgyad bzhi'i rang bzhin ngang rdzogs pa// bdud dang gshin rje ma mo gnod sbyin tshogs// zhag gi gshed chen rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// nga dang nga yir 'dzin 'khrul log rtog gshed// 'phags pa'i bden pa rnam bzhi'i ngo bo gang*// dus bzhi srid pa'i lha chen bzhi bstan pa// sgo skyong rnam pa bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod// ma rig nying mang sna tshogs 'khrul blo'i gshed// ye shes rol pa'i rang rtsal dpag yas sprul// gcig nyid du mar snang ba bgrang yas 'khor// za ma'i gshin rje'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// chos brgyad gdags gzhi gyis dbye bcu drug gshed// stong gzhi dga' bas dbye ba bcu drug dngos// 'obs srung dregs pa bcu drug dmag dpon bcas// dam can srung ma'i tshogs la bdag bstod do// zhes bstod// dam tshig gsol ba ni/

hoḥ shin tu mos pas rtag tu phyag btsal nas// 'gro la phan phyir khro rgyal khyod bsgrub na// mi mthun phyogs rnams rdul du rlog pa dang*// yab yum 'bar ba'i sku mchog bstan du gsol// yab yum sku dang mnyam sbyor nas// sangs rgyas zhing du bdag bsgrubs pas// khro rgyal 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du// phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// ya ma badz+ra kro dha sa ma ya hūm̐ hoḥ bzlas pa bya ba ni/ bdag zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor phyed bshags tsam gyi steng du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i dbus su hūm̐ mthing nag /lha gzhan rnams kyi thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sran ma phyed bshags pa re re tsam gsal ba'i dbus rnams su/ ya ma rā dzar ya mthing nag /dregs par hūm̐ ljang nag /rus sbal la srog gi dwangs ma ka dang las kyi dwangs ma a+yai srin po'i dwangs ma dmar ser/ bya khyung khroṃ dkar po| yum gsum la ma mthing nag re re/ gzhan pho lha thams cad la ya dang*/ mo lha thams cad la ma re re rang mdog dang mtshungs pa/ mtha' skor du rang rang gi sngags kyi phreng bas g.yas su bskor ba/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa phyogs thams cad du spros/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sras dang bla ma yi dam dpa' bo dang dpa' mo chos skyong srung ma dang bcas pa thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ de rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu byin rlabs thams cad bsdus te rang la thim pas nus pa thob/ slar 'od 'phros/ khams gsum gyi sems can la phog /sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'jam dpal khro bo'i go 'phang la bkod/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ brtan g.yo snod bcud kyi phun tshogs thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus pa rang la thim par bsam zhing*/ a+ye he a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa hrīḥṣ+ṭī a pa ye hūm̐/

zhes pa gtso bo'i snying po ste/ a+ye thung zla ba gcig gis 'grub ces gsungs pas/ zla ba gcig tu bzla'o// de rjes/ a+ye dun ka yaṃ/ nye snying 'bru 'bum tsam bzla/ gzhan rnams kyi sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ gang bzlas de'i thugs ka'i sa bon sngags bcas las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas phrin las thams cad bsgrubs/ tshur thim par bsams pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a āḥhūm̐ dzaḥni bstod bskul chen mo sogs su ma bshad kyang sgrub thabs snying gzer nag por bshad do// dzaḥ a+ye be tā lī kro dhī shwa rī hūm̐/ sbyor yum mo// a+ye ma mo e ka tsa ti hūm̐/ sgrol yum mo| |a+ye dhe ma kā lī baṃ ril ru lu ru lu bh+yo hūm̐/ dbyings yum mo// a+ye ya ma rā tsa kro dha hūm̐/ ya ma'o// a+ye badz+ra kro dha ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐/ dregs pa'o// a+ye ma hā bhe ru ta ka ye hūm̐/ mchog go// a+ye khroṃ ga ru ḍa hūm̐/ khyung gi'o// a+ye ka he dun ya ma rā dza hūm̐/ gyad gnon brgyad kyi'o// a+ye ya ma du sha hūm̐/ sku sprul lo// a+ye ya ma rak+sha hūm̐/ gsung sprul lo// a+ye ya ma yak+sha hūm̐/ thugs sprul lo// a+ye ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ srin po'o// ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ gshin rje'o// ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya/ bdud do// ya k+ṣe ya tsa ni ra ma ya/ gnod sbyin no// tsaṇ+ḍa ru tra mon+ta dzaḥ dung mon no// ya ma mon+ta dzaḥ lcags mon no// rak+sha mon+ta dzaḥ bse mon no// yak+sha mon+ta dzaḥ gser mon no// du tri ru lu ha ha ya/ he le'o// du ru ya ma snying du ya/ 'dzum med do// ru tra bha ti ru sha ya/ so brdar ro// ru tra yak+sha tig na ya/ ral pa'o// e ya ma rā dza/ kro ne kro ne/ pa tra pa tra/ shū la shū la/ da sha grī ba/ yak+sha grī wa/ ru lu ru lu/ ha ha ya ya/ zla ba'i'o// ma mo re ma ti/ ma bhar ma ni/ ma bhi su ni/ man tsa muṇ+ḍi/ ma bzhi'o// bdud ru tra ha la nag po/ ya ma du na rak+sha ya/ ru ru tsa pa la/

kha la rak+mo thun bh+yo/ yak+ṣa tig nan baṃ bh+yo/ zhag gi'o// tri tsa pa la a shu me ya/ ma hā kā lā ya/ ru tra du ru ya/ yak+sha ru lu ha ya/ sgo'o| |ya ma ya ma/ du na du na/ shaṃ shaṃ/ ghṛ ṇa ghṛ ṇa/ pa tsa pa tsa/ hu la hu la/ be ra be ra/ ha la ha la/ hu la ya hu la ya/ ma ma ru ru/ nag po ha dhe hṛ ta ya hṛ ta ya/ nṛ la dun bh+yo dun bh+yo ya/ za mi'o// de'ang*/ phrin las gang 'dod sham bur bcas// gtso la khri la yum la stong*// 'khor la brgya 'dzab bzlas pas 'grub// ces dang*/ gtso bo brgya la 'khor la bdun// gang 'phrod rnal 'byor don dang sbyar// zhes dang*/ rtags dang bstun pa'i grangs mang nyung yang bsnyen pa brgya stong khri 'bum bzla/ zhes rab brgya 'bring stong tha ma khri/ tha shal gyis kyang 'bum gyis 'grub par gsungs pa rnams ni rang nyams dang bstun no// bsnyen rtags mthong nas dngos grub kyi las sbyor ni/ thod pa mtshan ldan du myos byed la a mṛ ta sbyar ba dar nag gis kha bkab/ phur thun sogs drag po'i rdzas bshams la/ rang zil gnon gyi dpral bar oṃ dkar/ mgrin par āḥdamar/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing*/ lte bar trāṃ ser/ gsang bar hrīḥljang rnams gsal/ sgrol yum gyi thugs ka'i dzaḥlas 'od dkar 'phros/ oṃ la phog /oṃ las 'od zer dkar po phyogs bcur 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong khro bo khro mo dregs pa gshin rje'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi sku la 'od phog /sku'i byin rlabs thams cad rang la thim pas bdag gi lus gzi brjid dang ldan par bsams la/ a+ye ka ya ma he dun rak+sha dun dun dza ya a/ zhes sku'i sngags 'bru bcu gsum pa bzla/ khri'am 'bum rdzogs nas/ de bzhin du/ rang zil gnon gyi dpral bar oṃ dkar/ mgrin par āḥdamar/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing*/ lte bar trāṃ ser/ gsang bar hrīḥljang rnams gsal/ sgrol yum gyi thugs ka'i dzaḥlas 'od dmar 'phros|

āḥl phog /āḥlas 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong khro bo khro mo dregs pa gshin rje'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi gsung la 'od phog /gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad rang la thim pas bdag gi ngag nus pa dang ldan par bsams la/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ zhes gsung gi sngags 'bru bcu gnyis pa'i bzlas pa rdzogs nas/ rang zil gnon gyi dpral bar oṃ dkar/ mgrin par āḥdamar/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing*/ lte bar trāṃ ser/ gsang bar hrīḥljang rnams gsal/ sgrol yum gyi thugs ka'i dzaḥlas 'od mthing nag 'phros/ hūm̐ la phog /hūm̐ las 'od zer mthing nag phyogs bcur 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong khro bo khro mo dregs pa gshin rje'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs la 'od phog /thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad rang la thim pas bdag gi yid chen po'i bdag por gyur par bsams la/ a+ye myag ya rngub mug shag ka dun/ zhes thugs kyi sngags 'bru brgyad pa rdzogs nas/ rang zil gnon gyi dpral bar oṃ dkar/ mgrin par āḥdamar/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing*/ lte bar trāṃ ser/ gsang bar hrīḥljang rnams gsal/ sgrol yum gyi thugs ka'i dzaḥlas 'od ser 'phros/ trāṃ la phog /trāṃ las 'od zer ser po phyogs bcur 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong khro bo khro mo dregs pa gshin rje'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi yon tan la 'od phog /yon tan gyi byin rlabs thams cad rang la thim pas bdag gi thod pa'i rdzas yid bzhin gyi nor bu ltar gyur par bsams la/ sngags gsum po dril bzlas rdzogs nas/ rang zil gnon gyi dpral bar oṃ dkar/ mgrin par āḥdamar/

thugs kar hūm̐ mthing*/ lte bar trāṃ ser/ gsang bar hrīḥljang rnams gsal/ sgrol yum gyi thugs ka'i dzaḥlas 'od ljang 'phros/ hrīḥl phog |hrīḥlas 'od zer ljang gu phyogs bcur 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong khro bo khro mo dregs pa gshin rje'i lha tshogs thams cad kyi phrin las la 'od phog /phrin las kyi byin rlabs thams cad rang la thim pas bdag gi phur thun sogs drag po'i rdzas nus mthu dang ldan par bsams la/ sngags gsum po dril nas bzla| phrin las bsnyen pa'i skabs rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis 'jig rten khams kyi dregs pa pho mo klu gsum gyis bsdus pa thams cad bkug /phur thun sogs drag po'i rdzas la yang yang bstim pa gal che/ rdzogs nas tshogs dang bskang bshags bya/ rang gi gnas lnga'i yi ge lnga dang sgrol yum gyi thugs ka'i dzaḥrnams lha yab yum du gyur pa dngos grub kyi rdzas la bstim/ slar dngos grub kyi rdzas de las yig 'bru drug po thon te rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim/ dngos grub kyi rdzas phud sngar sman mchod rdzas dang bcas la lha la 'bul/ bar pa rang gis btung*/ lhag ma sgrub rdzas gzhan la bsre'o// de nas/ rang zil gnon du gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar/ mgrin par āḥdamar/ thugs khar hūm̐ mthing*/ bya khyung ya ma dregs pa rus sbal yum gsum gyi thugs ka'i sa bon rnams la a+yai ring sa bon so so'i mdog mthun re res g.yas su bskor ba rnams las 'od zer dang*/ rtsa ba'i lha drug gi zhal nas drag sngags me'i rang bzhin thugs ka nas khro chung mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams pa spros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la phog pas sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi nus pa thams cad bsdus nas rang la bstim/ slar spros khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad la phog sgrib pa sbyangs/

byad ma dgra bgegs la phog pas 'od zer spu gri ngar ma lta bus byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa thams cad bsgral nas nus pa thams cad rang la bstim/ rang lus kyi nang khro chung gis khengs shing phyi khro bo'i gur khang du gyur/ yang 'phro 'du gcig gis gser gyi tsakra/ gnyis pas lcags kyi tsakra/ gsum pas rdo rje'i gur/ bzhi pas mtshon cha sna tshogs/ lnga pas me ri'i gur/ drug pas gzhal yas khang phyi mchod rten rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang gi rang bzhin sgo bzhi mon pa bzhis bsrungs pa/ thod skam nang gi khrag 'thung lnga'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/ thams cad he ru ka'i rang bzhin khro bo mthing nag /g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon 'khor lo bsnams pa/ zhal phyir lta bas srung bar bsam/ a+yai a+yai a+yai/ sngags byang snye ma dkar por a+yai ring gi mgor o bcug pa yod pas byas pa legs a kro dang ka pa dang hrīḥṣ+ṭī gsum gyi mthar yi ge gsum btags pa ni ur mo gyang 'gyel las bzhi dang po srung ba'i dus ni sku gsung thugs kyi yig 'bru gsum man ngag tu bsdebs la bzla zhes gsungs pa'i don yin pa'o// a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ya ma ye oṃ/ kā la rū pa ka pa ye āḥ hrīḥṣ+ṭī a pa ye hūm̐/ a ā ni ā ni/ u ū ni ū ni/ du dū ni dū ni/ a i u e/ o aṃ/ ra rī/ la lī/ du ru ye/ bya tsa ye/ singha ye/ hri ta ye/ bhe ta ye/ tsit+ta ye/ ha la ye/ mu kha ye/ u u ni/ u u+u ni/ bi kṛ tā/ a a na na/ ya ma rā tsa/ ya ma rak+ṣa/ ya ma rak+sha/ ya ma raka a/ be tā lī/ kro dhī shwa rī/ ma ma e ka tsa ti/ dhe ma kā lī baṃ ril ru lu ru lu/ shrī badz+ra kro dha ya ma/ karma ro ṣa ṇa/ kro dha tsaṇ+ḍa/ rak+sha mon+ta āḥhūm̐ dzaḥ lcags sdig rnam shes snying ga'i pho brang las/ sngags byang snye ma dkar po las// brgya dang bzhi bcu tsheg bar tshang*| |bsnyen pa'i sngags su rgyud nas gsungs// sgrub thabs kun tu bcol gyur pa// nges par gnad kyi don 'dir bstan// spu gri btags nas bsnyen byas na// rang gi tshe dang 'khor la nyes pa 'ong*// dper na/

go med rno mtshon thogs nas su// g.yul du zhugs na rang nyid phung*// lha bsnyen rdzogs par gyur pa dang*// sngags kyi dbye ba shes par bya// zhes gsungs so// zhes mi'i tshig gis bar mi chod par bzlas pa'ang*/ ji skad du/ bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bdun gyis 'grub// ces dang*/ yang*/ a+yai ring sgrub pa gang 'grub gyis// 'bum phrag bdun gyis 'grub par gsungs// āḥhūm̐ btags la bzla bar bya// zhes dang*/ yang*/ āḥhūm̐ dzaḥgasum btags byas la// bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bdun gyis 'grub/ ces dang*/ yang*/ sgrub pa dngos grub ma thob na// las rnams thams cad ye mi 'grub// gshin rje'i mkhan po ltog par 'gyur// mthu dang nus pa 'byung mi 'gyur// zhes dang*/ yang*/ a+yai ring 'bum phrag gsum du bzla// de yis lus sbyong lus lha 'grub// ces mang mthar 'bum phrag bdun/ nyung mthar 'bum gsum bzla bar dgos gsungs pa ltar bzla/ stong srog 'di rgyun bsnyen yang bya ste/ de'i tshe dmigs pa ni/ rang zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthar/ a+yai ring g.yas su bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ phyi nang snod bcud yi ge'i rnam par gyur/ yar 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems mchod/ mar 'phros rigs drug gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ phar 'phros dregs pa thams cad zil gyis mnan/ las kyi gshin rje thams cad la phog /bdag gi bka' dbang du byas nas ci bcol ba'i las thams cad byed par bsams la bzla'o// a+yai ring bsnyen sgrub kyi dmigs pa lcags sdig rang gzhung du mi 'dra ba mang du yod kyang 'dir mdor bsdus tsam bris pa yin no// a+yai ring zlog dkrug dmar len 'bru gshag spel ma dang gzhan yang 'khor lo la brten pa'i las sbyor/ mchan/ sogs ni gzhung nyid nas rtogs dgos la/ khyad par gzir zhing stobs bshig byas pa bshig /zug pa dbyung dang gsang lam dgag /zlog dang mnan pa'i spyang mo drug

/ces gsungs pa'i sngags kyis so// zlog pa dang*/ dgongs don yang zab phyir/ gud du sbas pa las rtogs par bya'o// dzāpa bstod bskul ni/ hūm̐ */ dbus na rang byung grub pa'i lha// bcom ldan khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum// ma gsal bar du 'bad de bsgom// ma grub bar du mi gtang zhing*// rtse gcig mos pas bsgrub par bya// sku la rang byung grub pa'i lha// rtsa ba'i lha drug gyad gnon bcas// ma gsal bar du 'bad de bsgom// ma grub bar du mi gtang zhing*// rtse gcig mos pas bsgrub par bya// 'khor gyi rang byung grub pa'i lha// sprul pa gsum dang gshed bcu gnyis// 'chi bdag bcu gnyis ma mo bzhi// gshin rje so gnyis sgo ba bzhi// gshin rje bdun brgya 'obs bsrung bcas// ma gsal bar du 'bad de bsgom// ma grub bar du mi gtang zhing*// rtse gcig mos pas bsgrub par bya// hūm̐ */ ye shes lha yi thugs dam gnad nas bskul// rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyams chags zhig ral gso// lha dang gnyis su med par mnyes sbyar nas// bzlas brjod grangs dang dus kyi mchod pa 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā man+t+ra pū dza a la la hoḥ zhes dang*/ thun mthar bshags pa ni/ hūm̐ */ zil gnon lha tshogs gsan cing dgongs su gsol// dam can mchog khyod sgrub par dam bcas kyang*// sku yi phyag rgya ma gsal sngags ma dag /thugs kyi ting 'dzin g.yel zhing klong ma gyur// lta spyod dgongs pa'i gnad rnams nyams pa dang*// bsnyen sgrub las sbyor don rnams ma rtogs 'khrul// dam rdzas mchod gtor dus kyi mchod pa nyams// nyams dang 'grogs sogs 'gal 'khrul ci bgyis pa// gnong 'gyod sems kyis rtse gcig bshags bgyi na// bzod par bzhes la tshangs pa don 'grub pa'i// dngos grub rnam gnyis dus 'dir bstsal du gsol// ā di kā di dang ya ma rā dza'i yig brgya brjod/

rdzogs rim ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dkar dmar mthing gar a+yai ring mdog mthun gsum gyis bskor zhing ngag tu a+yai ring tshar gsum brjod pa'i sngags sgra 'od zer dang bcas pa khams gsum pa'i snod bcud thams cad dang bsgoms pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa/ nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar skad cig gis 'od gsal stong pa chen por bcug /rang sems zil gnon zhal phyag mtshan 'dzin spros pa'i mtha' las 'das pa chos dbyings bsam sgom dang bral ba/ ma bsam lhug par bzhag pas 'phro 'du las 'das pa/ so ma ye shes chos kyi sku gsal ba mtshan ma med pa thun tshad med pa chos nyid rang dang ma bral ba/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i ngang las sna tshogs sprul skus 'gro ba 'dren pa de'i ngang du cham mer bzhag /ngag rlung la oṃ la rngub/ āḥl gnas/ hūm̐ la spro ba rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang ma bral bar yun bsrings shing*/ slar ldang ba na 'od gsal stong 'byams de'i ngang la nam langs nyi ma shar ba ltar sngar bsgoms pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad tshig bsher mi bya bar skad cig sgyu ma lta bu snang la rang bzhin med par lam gyis gsal btab la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas brtan par byas te de'i gsal snang dang ma bral bar bya'o// tshogs mchod ni/ zhing ngam gcan gzan pags pa'i steng du kha na ma tho ba spangs pa'i sha zan ma da na/ gzhan yang bza' btung g.yos sbyar gyi zas sna tshogs pa bshams/ thod tshal du dmigs bya'i mur+dha dug khrag gis sbags pa phur thun mtshon gtun sogs bshams/ nya bo ma gtogs tshogs rdzas me chu rlung gis sbyangs/ hūm̐ */ bdag nyid zil gnon thugs srog las// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ spros tshogs la phog /ye shes me yis dngos 'dzin bsregs// dbang chen rlung gis nyes tshogs gtor// dag byed chu yis dri ma bkrus// yongs su dag pa'i rdzas su gyur// raṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ yaṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa yaṃ/

khaṃ badz+ra bi shud+dhe khaṃ/ bdud rtsi bran la/ hūm̐ */ slar yang rang lha'i thugs srog las// bh+rūṃ ser oṃ dkar āḥdamar po// hūm̐ mthing hoḥyig ljang gu spros// bh+rūṃ gyis tshogs snod dung chen po// oṃ gyis tshogs rdzas 'dod yon bsgyur// āḥyis de nyid du mar spel// hūm̐ gis dri ro gzi 'od 'bar// hoḥyis dam tshig bdud rtsi byas// bh+rūṃ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ cha gsum spel la dang po sman raka gtor mar bsgron la/ hūm̐ */ chos dbyings drag po'i zhing khams nas// phyag rgya zil gnon 'khor dang bcas// ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir bzhugs// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos// phyag rgya glu gar 'dod yon lnga// sman raka gtor ma dam rdzas sogs| |'bul gyi bzhes la dngos grub stsol// e ka he dun ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ bar pa bsgron la/ hūm̐ */ tshogs kyi 'khor lo sman rak+ta// gtor ma phyi nang gsang mchod kyi// zil gnon 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang*// bskangs gyur dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// hūm̐ */ bdag cag 'khrul blos dkrugs pa yis// rgyu chung phud nyams lhag ma 'dres| |de sogs nongs gyur gang bgyis pa// mthol bshags bzod bzhes tshangs par mdzod// yig brgya brjod/ tha ma gser skyems bshams la/ kye/ bla ma yi dam dpang du bzhugs// dam can rgya mtshos legs nyes phyes// sde brgyad dregs pas zhal lce chod// bdag ni ma nyes ma 'gal yang*// dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'dis// bslu med rgyu 'bras khyad du bsad// zhing bcu tshang ba'i las bsags kyi// de bas 'gugs bsgral dus la bab// ces brjod/ e/ thod tshal brub khung bsad khang nang*// nṛ las dmigs bya phung khams sogs// sems rig dngos 'dra skad cig gsal// 'gugs shing bsgral ba'i dus la bab// ces brjod/ 'gugs 'dren drag po ci rigs byas la/

/lho ru rgyas pa'i bro brdungs pas// tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par shog /nub tu dbang gi bro brdungs pas// lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud// byang du drag po'i bro brdungs pas// dgra bgegs dam sri sgrol bar shog /a+ye a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa/ hrīḥṣ+ṭī bi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba ba yā pa kā ri ṇaṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sarba ā yuḥpuṇ+yai puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sarba trai lo kya wa sh+yaṃ ku ru swā hā/ sarba sha trūṃ a mu kaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐ */ mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku dag pa la// ma 'gags rang mdangs 'jam dpal ye shes sems| |rang rtsal rol pa phyag rgya zil gnon che// gtso dang 'khor bcas ye shes sgyu ma'i gar// sna tshogs ston mdzad rol par chub pa'i tshogs// dus 'dir bdag la dngos grub bstsal du gsol// kye/ rdo rje srin po'i nam langs nye// bskyed rdzogs man ngag mtha' ru phyin// bzlas brjod dgongs pa klong du gyur// sgrub pa'i zhag kyang thems lags kyi// dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab// dmigs bcas thun mong tshe bsod dpal// srid zhi'i phun tshogs phrin las bzhi// gang bsam 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol// dmigs med don dam dngos grub che// bstsal dang stsol ba mi mnga' yang*// ye khyab 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// chos sku 'byams klas 'grub par mdzod// oṃ ya mān+ta ka kā ya wāka tsit+ta gu ṇa kāraya sarba sid+dhi pha la sā dha ka s+ya pra yats+tshan+tu| |zhes sman raka gtor mar cung zad rol// bshags pa ni/ hoḥ phyag rgya chen po'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol// bdag cag ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang song bas// bskyed rdzogs bzlas brjod 'chal zhing nor 'khrul nyams// dam rdzas ma tshang phrin las sbyor kha log /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig las 'das dang*// chad lhag 'gal nongs gyur pa de thams cad// ma gshin dregs pa'i tshogs la mthol lo bshags// rab gnong 'gyod pas snying nas bshags zin gyi// lha tshogs rnams kyis bzod cing tshangs par mdzod// bshags kyang mi 'tshal tshangs par mi dgongs na// lha tshogs yongs kyi sgrib par mi 'gyur ram// de bas bdag la tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol// ces dang*/

ya ma rā dza'i yig brgya ci nus 'bad/ gshegs bsdu spro na/ hoḥ rang rig gdod ma'i zil gnon la| |gshegs su gsol ba med mod kyang*// kun rdzob tsam du ye shes pa// gshegs nas slar yang 'byon par gsol// badz+ra muḥ nyer bsdu bya/ spro na/ hoḥ bdag gis sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams// bdag thugs 'od kyis reg ma thag /phyi snod gzhal yas nang bcud lha// gsal ba snod bcud 'od gsal du// bsdus te rten dang brten par thim| |rten ni brten pa dag la thim// kun kyang rang gi thugs kar bsdu// srung 'khor mi bsdu 'od du 'bar// thugs srog hūm̐ yang 'ja' ltar du// dmigs med 'od gsal stong pa'i dbyings| |slar yang zil gnon phyag gnyis pa// mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin gyur// ces bsgom/ nyer bsdu 'di rgyud sde spyi'i dbang du byas kyi/ lcags sdig rang gzhung gi mngon rtogs dang*/ sgrub thabs rnams su med pas ma byas kyang legs so// smon lam ni/ e ma hoḥ 'di dge rnam dkar gdengs can dbang po yis// bdag la dngos grub rnam gnyis bai ḍūr+ya// bstsal des 'gro ba kun gyi re ba'i don// 'bad med skong ba nyid du deng gyur cig /'jam dpal ji ltar mkhyen cing dpa' ba dang*// kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob cing*// dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo| |dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis// bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des// bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang*// bzang po spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi| |shis brjod ni/ hūm̐ */ shes bya kun la ma rmongs pa'i// bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dngos grub ma lus ster ba'i dpal// yi dam mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shog /mthu dpung nus pa mchog ldan pa// chos skyong srung ma'i bkra shis shog /legs pa'i yon tan rab rgyas pa// ci bsam 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog

/sku gsung thugs dang ye shes lnga// phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog /ces so// rgyun spyod dus kun tu snang grag rtog gsum thams cad lha sngags ting 'dzin kyi rnam rol du mos shing shar ba las mi 'da' bar bya bar gal che'o// zla gsang gtum po'i 'od snang cher 'bar ba'i// zer phreng phrin las phyogs brgyar spro ba 'dis| |thar 'dod blo yi pad tshal rgyas pa dang*// log lta'i ku mud 'joms pa cig car byas// blo gros sprin sngon rol pa las 'ongs pa'i// phrin las gru char rtag tu 'bebs 'di yis// 'gro khams byang chub myu gu cher bsrings nas// dpal mgon 'bras drug smin la bdag yid spro// 'dir nyes gzhan skyon ma yin bdag gis nongs// gzhan legs 'di ru ma 'dzud lhad yin phyir// yul 'dre'i khol po mgo skyes khur 'chang bas// deng sang sa steng khyab dang 'di mi mnyam// de ltar 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag lcags sdig gnam thog me'i skor gyi phrin las snying po bsdus pa zhes bya ba 'di'ang 'on rin chen brag gi bla ma dge slong dkon mchog lhun grub nas nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ rang nyid kyis nyams su blang ba dang don gnyis sgrub 'dod snying la brnags pa'i skal ldan gzhan la'ang phan pa'i bsam pa nye bar bzhag ste/ lcags sdig mgo bo las chad pa'i chos sde sgrub thabs snying gzer nag po/ brdung pa'i rwa gnyis las ur mo gyang 'gyel las bzhi/ gnyer ma dang po gsum las sgrub thabs mngon rtogs bstod bskul che ba gsum/ stod dril nyi ma shar ba las byang chub sgrub pa'i chos sde sogs lcags sdig gnam thog me'i skor gnubs lugs gtsor byas siṅga la'i slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang*/ u rgyan gyi mkhan po pad+ma saṃ bha wa dang*/ rgya gar gyi khrag 'thung nag po dang*/ dur khrod kyi slob dpon khrag 'thung nag po dang*/ phung byed shan+tiṃ gar+bha sogs nas brgyud/

slob dpon ba su dha ras gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la gtad/ des pha bong g.yu sgor sbas pa rgya zhang khrom gyis gter du bzhes pa/ las byang sdig pa snying 'dzing gi sngags dang slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis nub phyogs siṅga la dmar smug tshal gyi dur khrod du tshe bdag nag po'i rgyud don bsdus te mdzad cing sgrub pa sogs kyi pad gnubs thun mong gi yig sna 'ga' zhig legs pa'i cha rnams kyang bsdus/ gnubs lugs gtsor bton la pad lugs dang yang mi 'gal bar bgyis pa 'di la/ zla gsang rgyud sde rtsa bshad man ngag phyi ma'i rgyud sogs rgyud chen bcu phrag gsum lhag la 'dris par byas shing*/ lhag par tshe bdag gnubs lugs/ phyi skor lcags 'dra/ nang skor thog 'dra/ gsang skor gnam thog me'i skor gnam lcags chos sde chen po gsum la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa'i nges pa rnyed par byas/ pad lugs sogs gzhung 'di'i thun mong gi gsung tsam du 'gro ba'i chos skor rnams la'ang goms par byas pa/ skyu ra'i gdung las shākya'i dge slong dus mtha'i sngags pa thugs kyi rdo rje zhes sam chos kyi grags pa zhes 'bod pas/ lcags yos sa ga can gyi dkar po'i rgyal ba dang por/ 'bri dam pa chos phyug sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu 'bad pas bris pa pad gnubs gnyis ka'i nyams len mdor dril du gdams pa zab cing gnad che ba yin no// las byang 'di khong pa'i snying las gces 'dzin par rigs pa yod do// las byang 'dir gtso bo/ yum gsum/ sprul pa gsum/ gshed bzhi/ mon pa bzhi/ bdud bzhi/ 'chi bdag bcu gnyis/ gshin rje so gnyis/ sgo ba bzhi rnams te gtso bo'i yum gsum ma gtogs gzhan rnams yab yum so sor ma phye zhing*/ phyi'i khyams kyi za gshed 'khor yug gi 'obs srung mi the bar dkyil 'khor gyi nang du lha grangs drug cu rtsa bdun yod do// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
